tier1.text: The hindbrain includes the cerebellum, which controls balance and helps coordinate movement. The hindbrain also includes the pons, the cerebellum's main link to the rest of the brain. The pons and the medulla oblongata, the third part, help control the heart and breathing. The hindbrain is the back region of the brain.
